prompt: theCore STM32F407G-DISC1 STLINK V2.1 OpenOCD config file
answer:
For the STM32F407G-DISC1, use an OpenOCD board configuration that references:

```text
interface/stlink-v2-1.cfg
```

The existing `stm32f4discovery.cfg` can be adapted by replacing:

```text
find interface/stlink-v2.cfg
```

with:

```text
find interface/stlink-v2-1.cfg
```

A dedicated configuration is also referred to as:

```text
stm32f407g_disc1.cfg
```

This is required because the STM32F407G-DISC1 uses the newer ST-LINK/V2-1 interface.
